purpose: Twelve-variant follow-up: independently attributable primary material, clearly separated secondary summaries and bounded mathematical scenarios. Research only, no simulator parameter change. A reprint of an original report remains primary but a modern author interpreting it is secondary. Different serials never become direct matched-source evidence.

sources.work: Wright Field Eng-47-1749-A Fig.1 original position error chart, 20 May 1944
sources.location: Original Fig.1 chart, points approximately 140–330 mph IAS; physical scan preserved in references/import/04_ADDITIONAL_USER_SUPPLIED_FIGURES/P51B_airspeed_calibration_rotated.png

sources.work: USAAF PHQ-M-19-1417-A original acceptance trial, 18 June 1942
sources.location: Original configuration: gross 12565lb, CG32%MAC, R-2800-21 and Curtiss 714-1C2-12; calibration only from 170mph IAS

sources.aircraft: Spitfire Mk IX/XI/XVI family, NOT unique BS543
sources.work: Air Ministry 3rd-edition A.P.1565 P&L Pilot Notes, September 1946
sources.location: Operating data paras 51–52 and handling paras 42–43; original operating notes, no numeric BS543 stall CAS

sources.aircraft: P-38D through P-38G series (manual scope), not a calibrated trial on G-1 42-12687
sources.work: AAF T.O. 01-75F-1, 1 Oct 1942 revised 30 Sep 1944
sources.location: Contents explicitly lists Airspeed Correction Table, printed p28, and P-38G-specific weight and flight instruction charts. Page 28 numeric table not yet retrieved in machine-readable form.

sources.aircraft: Captured Fw190 A-4 fighter-bomber, NOT WNr783; Navy F6F-3 and F4U-1 trials
sources.work: US Navy TED PTR-1107, comparative performance and maneuver trials, March 1944
sources.location: Comparative report weights and turn-test matrix, Fw190 8690lb; F6F3 12406lb; F4U1 11988lb. Qualitative comparative turn findings at 10000–15000ft.

sources.aircraft: Captured Fw190 radial family, serial not resolved; NOT WNr783
sources.work: Wright Field Eng-47-1658-D, 1943, original captured handling report
sources.location: Original stall IAS 118mph clean and 105mph gear/flaps down, power off. Other captured aircraft reports disagree on stall warning severity.

sources.aircraft: Kittyhawk II FL220 Packard Merlin V-1650-1; NOT P-40F AAF 41-13635
sources.work: A&AEE/783a Part 4, 15 October 1942, original FL220 performance/correction-method trial
sources.location: Original p1–5, 8910lb takeoff, 2020ft/min at10200ft MS, 1620ft/min at17000ft FS; PEC transferred from a different Kittyhawk I A.K.672 without original correction table included

sources.aircraft: Kittyhawk II FL220, not AAF 41-13635
sources.work: A&AEE/783a Part 5, engine cooling trials, original report located as archive catalogue entry
sources.location: Smithsonian Wright Field archival index confirms Part 5 exists; numerical cooling figures not accessed. Search lead, not numeric power calibration.

sources.work: NACA RM L8A06, original flying qualities/stall and control tests, 18 February 1948
sources.location: Figure legends 47–55 document original exact run masses, CG, altitude and flap/power condition. Figure 58 inconsistent altitude labels remain unresolved. No near-stall CAS established.

sources.work: Wright Field Eng-47-1774-A, 15 July 1944, R-2800-63 + 44-1 fuel comparison
sources.location: Section III 13230lb takeoff, 29.9%MAC; section IV handling; section V original 13 explicitly uncorrected cockpit IAS stall/config rows; report Fig1 PEC not digitally available at low speed

sources.aircraft: F6F-3 BuNo40164, NOT NACA 04776
sources.work: US Navy PTR-2125 Periodic Performance Check, 16 March 1944
sources.location: Original p1 summary, overload fighter 12243lb and four mph stall points; indicator/CAS status not explicitly resolved

sources.aircraft: F6F-3 BuNo42633, NOT NACA 04776
sources.work: US Navy PTR-2125 Periodic Performance Check, 1 September 1944
sources.location: Original p1 summary 12416lb with four mph stall points, no verified low-stall CAS correction

sources.aircraft: F6F-3 BuNo02982, NOT NACA 04776
sources.work: US Navy BIS-2116 Final Flight Report, 27 November 1944
sources.location: Original performance-summary transcription for 11364lb with four mph stall points; request scanned underlying BIS-2116 if numeric provenance needs strengthening

sources.aircraft: Chance Vought F4U-4 design specification, NOT BuNo80765 trial
sources.work: Vought Report 7289 Detail Specification for F4U-4, 21 May 1947
sources.location: Three loading categories 12405/13529/14562lb and manufacturer-computed stall figures. First figure 78.3kt at12405lb does NOT agree with later measured 89.4kt CAS clean/off at12500lb unless test definitions differ; not a flight calibration.

sources.aircraft: F4U-4 BuNo80765
sources.work: US Naval Air Test Center BIS 2157, 25 March 1948
sources.location: 12500lb and 89.4kt measured calibrated clean power-off stall; derived speed-versus-mass scenarios are NOT further flight-test data

sources.work: German Flugbericht Nr 1, original flight program, 1944
sources.location: 4300kg applies to climb run, not all speed points; closing radiator flaps at9000m added ~2m/s to climb; airspeed correction graph low-speed measured domain not certified

sources.aircraft: Ki84-I captured T2 serial302
sources.work: AAF interim report T-2, actual handling tests vs published aircraft specification
sources.location: Original pp5–8 distinguish three IAS stalls from published Ha45 rating and no measured performance climbs; original p8 is NOT an airspeed calibration chart

sources.aircraft: Bf109 F-4 representative DB601E, original source images not recovered
sources.work: Modern researcher discussion transcribes alleged Messerschmitt AG Flugzeug-Daten dated 29 Nov 1942 and 3 Feb 1943
sources.location: Different 'calculated' and 'flown' specifications 635km/h@6000m 1185PS, 660km/h@6200m 1180PS, 670km/h@6300m 1290PS; modern transcription only, conditional primary lead

sources.aircraft: Fw190D-9 and Bf109F-4 modern IL-2 models, NOT flight test
sources.work: Modern IL-2 simulation aircraft flight model reference
sources.location: D9 stated 174–197km/h IAS clean stall varying weight and SL20s/3000m29s turn at300km/h IAS, simulation check only

sources.aircraft: Multiple WWII fighter variants, secondary compilation of original trial narratives
sources.work: David Ince, Flying to the Limit, comparative wartime flight test synthesis
sources.location: P-47-versus-Fw190 RAF qualitative turn reversal near 250mph IAS, not maximum sustained turn rate; RAF different airframes/conditions

sources.aircraft: Original NACA P-40E/F/F-1 family test, specimen not established as 41-13635
sources.work: NACA WR L-547 Vensel, Flight Measurements of Rudder Control and Sideslip Characteristics of Four Vertical Tail Arrangements, Oct 1942
sources.location: Original NACA experimental comparison explicitly including P-40F and P-40F-1 rudders and tails, not a wing stall or sustained-turn test

sources.aircraft: Captured Bf109 F-4 WNr7640, possibly F4/Z; EB-1 then EB-100
sources.work: USAAF wartime captured-aircraft custody trail, reconstructed serial register; original performance test not found
sources.location: WNr7640 reportedly transferred Soviet Union to Wright Field Nov1942, Eglin21Mar1944. Need original EB100 Wright Field/Eglin technical report; do not infer actual tests from serial custody

sources.aircraft: Bf109 F-2 WNr9209 DB601N, NOT Bf109F-4 DB601E
sources.work: Historical analysis of captured fighter 1942 Soviet NII-VVS investigations; secondary test-history synthesis
sources.location: Soviet test machine No9209 and F4 No7640 distinct; some forum times 19.6–20.5s mislabeled F4. Original 1km turn sheet not inspected and not treated as corroborated F4 sustained data

series.source_location: Eng-47-1749-A Fig1, same specimen; approximate plotted points only
series.conditions: Graph is cockpit instrument indicated vs fixed free-air head. Position error only; Kollsman D-1 instrument error not included. Scanned measured/drawn solid range about140–330mph IAS; dashed extrapolated below/above must not be used at actual 67–86mph IAS stall. Values rounded to ~1mph uncertainty. Sign per printed position error axis.

series.aircraft: F6F-3 BuNo40164
series.source_location: PTR2125 original March1944 summary table, overload fighter mass12243lb
series.conditions: Four recorded mph stalls at 12243lb published gross loading; IAS vs CAS not established; gross loading may not equal instantaneous fuel-burn-adjusted stall mass. NOT BuNo04776.

series.aircraft: F6F-3 BuNo42633
series.source_location: PTR2125 original September1944 summary table, overload fighter mass12416lb
series.conditions: Four original mph stall figures, mass is test loading not proven actual fuel-adjusted weight; IAS/CAS unestablished. Different BuNo from NACA04776.

series.aircraft: F6F-3 BuNo02982
series.source_location: BIS2116 original November1944 02982 summary on archived index
series.conditions: Four published mph stalls at11364lb gross context, not NACA04776. Correction method not audited; original PDF should still be sought.

series.source_location: NACA RM L8A06 Figure legends 47–51 and 53–55
series.conditions: These are actual NACA figure run weights and CG/altitudes, NOT 1g stall CAS, max sustained load factor, or airspeed calibration. An OCR-obscured figure52 mass intentionally omitted.

series.source_location: Eng-47-1774-A section V.D stalling speed table
series.conditions: 13 uncorrected ship indicator readings, 13230lb gross at TAKEOFF, 29.9%MAC and R2800-63 Curtiss836-2C2-18, but exact stall moment weight unreported; no transfer to P47D30 43-3441 CAS. Cowl/oil shutters and flaps affect stall.

series.aircraft: F4U-4 manufacturer 1947 design specification, NOT test BuNo80765
series.source_location: Vought Report7289 original summary, three load columns
series.conditions: Manufacturer 'stall at sea level full load no power' 78.3/81.7/84.6kt at three nominal masses; calibration basis and exact clean/landing condition unclear. These conflict numerically with later 1948 BuNo80765 clean/off 89.4kt CAS at12500lb. Explicit unresolved condition/basis discrepancy, do not fit both as equivalent.

series.aircraft: F4U-4 BuNo80765 mathematical scenarios
series.source_location: Derived by V_s(W)=89.4 kt * sqrt(W/12500lb), anchored only to BIS2157 original exact CAS 89.4kt at12500lb
series.conditions: Same lift coefficient, power off, configuration, density/airspeed conventions assumed. Does NOT infer physical CLmax change with mass, propwash, compressibility or CG. All masses in this series INCLUDING the repeated 12500 anchor are computational illustrations, not additional original trial observations or validated range. Original 12500 CAS lives only in the earlier pack.

series.aircraft: Fw190 A-4 jabo plus F6F-3 and F4U-1 separate original comparators
series.source_location: TED PTR1107 comparative turn test section
series.conditions: Different aircraft and serials from WNr783, NACA04776 and F4U4 80765. Initial IAS 140/160/180/200 knots; tests at 10000 and15000ft. Navy's F6F3/F4U1 inside Fw turn is a qualitative relative outcome, not deg/s, turn-time, steady power margin or a condition-matched F4U4 claim. Report says indicators calibrated but supplies no numeric near-stall correction.

series.aircraft: Captured Fw190 radial, separate serial from A-4 WNr783
series.source_location: Eng-47-1658-D original 1943 handling report
series.conditions: Power off 118mph IAS clean and105mph IAS landing; precise subvariant/serial and IAS installation calibration unknown. Different captured Fw reports disagree on stall warning and lateral break severity.

series.aircraft: Kittyhawk II FL220, Merlin V1650-1, NOT AAF 41-13635
series.source_location: A&AEE/783a Part4 15 October1942
series.conditions: Departure 8910lb; PEC for climb/speed adopted from earlier Kittyhawk I AK672, which was Allison variant. Original actual FL220 IAS climb control 160mph up to20kft, decreasing2mph per1000ft afterwards; full-open radiators on climb. Not a direct stall test or corrected 41-13635 CAS.

series.source_location: Flugbericht Nr1 climb narrative, 4300kg tested
series.conditions: At 9000m closing radiator flaps contributed ~2m/s extra rate of climb; opening/closing also changed critical altitude by ~700m. This is a conditional original model diagnostic, not a new stall or turn measurement. 4300kg known for climb only.

series.aircraft: Bf109 F-4 DB601E original-sheet secondary transcription
series.source_location: Forum transcription of alleged Messerschmitt 29 Nov1942/3 Feb1943 sheets; originals NOT viewed
series.conditions: 635km/h at6000m1185PS described CALCULATED, 660km/h at6200m1180PS described FLOWN, 670km/h at6300m1290PS FLOWN; different power clearances/condition likely. No original test specimen or near-stall CAS; do not score as directly inspected primary.

series.aircraft: Spitfire IX family, including Merlin66 LF IX variants but not specific BS543
series.source_location: A.P.1565 third edition 1946 handling and engine limits
series.conditions: Shows MkIX-series Merlin66 +18lb boost and3000rpm operating limits and stall-warning/buffet discussion. No numeric 1g speed or near-stall PEC, so no new BS543 CAS. Postwar issue, mixed variants cannot establish BS543 historical test parameters.

series.aircraft: P-38D through G manual, G-specific correction lead
series.source_location: T.O.01-75F-1 p28 correction table listed, p39 G flight operating instructions
series.conditions: The manual explicitly offers an Airspeed Correction Table, but its numeric content and G applicability were not retrieved; no corrections can be activated. Important next targeted archival acquisition. Serial42-12687 is G-1; manual lists different G-series submodels; check exact G-1 applicability.

series.aircraft: Ki84-I captured T2 302
series.source_location: AAF interim report printed pp7–8
series.conditions: Confirms no climb tests and no original low-speed IAS/CAS calibration in cited interim PDF. Source-audit proof avoids treating published nominal speed/rate or game-model turn times as historical measurements. Three prior 1g IAS stall entries not duplicated.

series.aircraft: Fw190D-9 modern IL-2 simulated variant, not WNr210002 wartime trial
series.source_location: IL-2 specifications, standard mass, emergency power
series.conditions: Maximum performance turn at300km/h IAS20sSL and29s3000m; listed clean stall IAS174–197km/h dependent on mass. Only software comparator, never source of original D9 CAS or historical independent sustained turn.

series.aircraft: P-47 and captured Fw190 RAF variants (separate from target P47B41-5902 and Fw190A4WNr783)
series.source_location: Flying to the Limit P47 chapter, wartime comparative flight account
series.conditions: Above roughly250mph IAS P47 relative turn advantage, below it Fw190 reportedly better; not a consistent measured maximum sustained turn, no matched aircraft masses/engines and no turn-time. Treat as hypothesis to test, not exact calibrated performance curve.

series.aircraft: P-40F and F-1 tail/rudder family configurations, NOT matched AAF41-13635
series.source_location: NACA WR L-547 citation and published test scope
series.conditions: Original report explicitly tests P40E/F and F-1 vertical-tail rudder/sideslip characteristics. The score gain is modest: no clean 1g stall, low-speed PEC, powered sustained-turn or serial41-13635 performance inferred.

series.aircraft: Bf109 F-4 WNr7640 EB1/EB100
series.source_location: WWII USA captured serial chronology
series.conditions: Known aircraft transfer path. No numerical performance test established; possible F4/Z configuration must be resolved. Search Wright Field EB100 and Eglin military intelligence original files before assigning high primary credit.

series.aircraft: Bf109F-2 WNr9209 DB601N, not modeled Bf109 F-4 DB601E
series.source_location: Sobolev/Khazanov Soviet wartime captured aircraft study and independent online turn-time folklore
series.conditions: Claims of F-4 Soviet 19.6–20.5s likely conflate DB601N F-2 WNr9209 (tested USSR) with DB601E F-4. Other wartime F-4 WNr7640 sent to USA, not USSR continued tests. No primary original turn plot located; numeric turn data intentionally not ingested as flight observation.
